title: Network Participation Agreements: Fee Schedule Updates and Opening or Closing a Panel
content:
This provision of the **Network Participation Agreements** covers two things: how Cascade changes a practice's fee schedule, and how a practice opens or closes its panel to new Cascade patients.

## Fee schedules

Fee schedules are updated on the agreement type's regular update cycle, which is annually on 1 January for every agreement type.

A material change takes effect only after the agreement type's fee schedule change notice has been given in writing. The practice may then terminate on the shorter material-change notice.

## Panel status

A panel status change is the practice's request. It takes effect the agreement type's panel status change notice days after confirmation. The confirmation is read from Cascade's record of the practice request for that same agreement, which must show the status "confirmed".

A DHMO primary care dentist may not close the panel while assigned members are below the panel capacity, where the agreement type carries the open-panel commitment. Under the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement, the commitment applies and the capacity is 1500 assigned members.

Closing a panel does not affect patients already treated by the provider.

## Points of judgement

| Situation (hypothetical) | Judgement |
|---|---|
| A PPO participating dentist's confirmed request to close the panel | Takes effect 30 days after confirmation |
| A DHMO primary care dentist with 1200 assigned members asks to close the panel | May not close (below 1500) |
| A DHMO primary care dentist with 1600 assigned members, request confirmed | Takes effect 60 days after confirmation |
| A long-standing patient returns after the panel closed | Not affected by the closure |
| A material fee reduction under the vision network agreement | Takes effect only after 90 days of written notice |
